goal: Help fragrance shoppers reduce a broad catalogue to three explainable recommendations without requiring perfumery vocabulary.

project_truth.visual_signature: warm violet consultation room: editorial serif scale, warm lilac/blush fields, aubergine ink, fine rules, large fragrance imagery and one quiet circular motif
project_truth.constraint: Keep familiar commerce controls predictable; distinctiveness belongs in composition, editorial rhythm and media treatment rather than novel control behavior.

page_role_composition_matrix.user_question: Which fragrance direction fits how I want to feel and be perceived?
page_role_composition_matrix.owner_message: Violet narrows choice through feeling and context, not marketplace overload.
page_role_composition_matrix.first_visual_anchor: two-pane consultation desk with an editorial Scent Portrait narrative
page_role_composition_matrix.media_treatment: 4:5 brand-neutral perfume photography with restrained category tone
page_role_composition_matrix.mobile_transformation: story becomes an introduction block; decision workspace follows in reading order

page_role_composition_matrix.user_question: Why are these scents right for me and what should I try next?
page_role_composition_matrix.owner_message: Three scents, not thirty; recommendations are transparent and intentionally limited.
page_role_composition_matrix.decision_object: three ranked products with a why-it-fits explanation
page_role_composition_matrix.mobile_transformation: single-column result stories with preserved explanations

interaction_contract.persistence: answers are preserved when moving backward during the current session
interaction_contract.recovery: back and restart never require page reload
interaction_contract.recommendation_truth: deterministic scoring over prototype product metadata; never represented as AI inference

success_criteria: Four meaningful questions and progress are visible and reversible.
Results contain exactly three ranked fragrances with an explicit why-it-fits explanation.
Desktop at 1440px has no horizontal overflow, console/page errors or broken visible images.
All option buttons expose selected state and keyboard-visible focus.
Without logo/header, the consultation/result screen still carries at least three independent Violet cues.
Visual QA uses actual rendered screenshots, not source assertions alone.
